body.p: After . Owns src/xslt_read.c (the XTSE1650 and XTSE1660 places), src/xslt_lower.c, src/xslt_lower_construct.c, src/xslt_static.c, src/function_library_xslt.c, tests/xslt/driver/ (schema_aware feature and schema environments), tests/xslt_schema_test.c. xsl:import-schema (namespace, schema-location, an inline xs:schema read as a NODE document; XTSE0220), validation and type attributes of xsl:element, xsl:attribute, xsl:copy, xsl:copy-of, xsl:document, xsl:result-document, literal result elements and xsl:source-document, default-validation, typed modes, validation of fn:doc and fn:document results (XTTE1510, XTTE1512, XTTE1515, XTTE1540, XTTE1550, XTTE1555, XTSE1520, XTSE1530), type-available and element-available for schema types, the system property is-schema-aware. Done when the in-scope XSLT 4.0 cases with feature schema_aware (about 690, mostly attr- and decl- sets) pass ≥ 60% and the XT40 count has not dropped. Done 2026-10-19 (): src/xslt_schema.c (xsl:import-schema), the validate row with XSLT's rules for every validation and type attribute, default-validation, input-type-annotations, typed modes, fn:document's xsd-validation, is-schema-aware, the driver's schema environments. 615 of the 679 in-scope schema_aware cases (90.6 %); XT40 8,642 passed (was 7,990).
